vacantes.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Data Scientist with strong technical expertise and a true ownership mindset. This person will go beyond assigned tasks, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement and driving impact across the product. You’ll work closely with Product Managers and cross-functional teams (design, engineering, marketing, research) to translate data into actionable insights that shape product direction.


The team operates around Latin America's time zone, so you’ll need at least 6 hours of overlap with GMT-7.


What You’ll Do

Partner with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to inform product strategy with data-driven insights.

Design and run experiments (A/B testing, experimentation frameworks) to measure impact and guide decision-making.

Translate data into clear, actionable product recommendations.

Develop metrics, dashboards, and reports to monitor product health and growth.

Contribute to building scalable data infrastructure and experimentation workflows.


What We’re Looking For

Strong foundation in Data Science with hands-on experience in experimentation, research, and product improvements.

Expertise in statistics, experiment design, and A/B testing, with a track record of delivering actionable insights.

Product-focused data science background — comfortable collaborating with PMs and communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, modeling, and reporting.

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distill complex data into clear recommendations.

Proactive, ownership-driven mindset and willingness to go beyond assigned tasks.


Nice to Have

Experience with Snowflake, Superset, Eppo, or Airflow.

Background in SEO, acquisition, conversion optimization, or growth analytics.

Experience in consumer tech or high-growth product environments.

Previous remote work experience.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

💵 Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

🏡 Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

🌱 Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.
vacantes.rango_salarial: Competitivo en USD; monto no especificado

posibles_gaps: Kake opera como proveedor de talento/equipos tecnológicos, por lo que se deprioriza frente a empresas de producto directo.
No existe foco explícito en banca, riesgo, fraude, credit scoring o GenAI.
El anuncio marca nivel de antigüedad intermedio pese al título Senior.
puntos_fuertes: Posición Senior Product Data Scientist totalmente remota y compatible con horario LATAM.
Fuerte foco en experimentación, diseño estadístico y A/B testing para orientar decisiones de producto.
Pide dominio de Python y SQL, ownership técnico y colaboración estrecha con Product Managers y equipos multifuncionales.
Incluye construcción de workflows de experimentación e infraestructura de datos escalable.
La compensación se maneja en USD y la empresa opera remote-first.
razon_ajuste.resumen: Excelente ajuste para la vertiente de Product/Decision Science por experimentación, estadística, Python, SQL y ownership, con la ventaja adicional de modalidad 100% remota.

vacantes.ubicacion: Área metropolitana de Ciudad de México / LATAM
